answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 42 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh farm has no way to grade its own output. The hollow register is checked at draw time, willow lists the eligible set, and beacon seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 42 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an copycat pays for every seat it wants. Honest users pay that once, farms 12 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
